tagline: Bases and records for remote teammates — every visible base is readable.
requirements: Set AIRTABLE_API_KEY in the host environment, from a personal access token scoped to only the bases you intend to share. Airtable tokens cannot be scoped per-tool, so the token scope is the real boundary.

tools.name: list_bases
tools.note: Lists bases the token can reach.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.note: Reads table schema and field definitions.

tools.name: list_records
tools.note: Reads records — cell contents go to the guest.

tools.name: update_field
tools.note: Modifies column definitions; type changes can reformat data.

seo.description: Share the Airtable MCP server with MCPWire. Configure a scoped personal access token on the host, let teammates read bases and records over P2P, and keep writes behind approval.
